title: Sheinbaum lands in Shenzhen on a commercial flight for the APEC summit
detail: Sheinbaum arrived in Shenzhen on Nov 16 at about 11:30 local time after leaving Mexico City on Nov 14 and flying from Tijuana on a China Southern commercial flight. Her first event was a meeting with Mexicans living in China. Her delegation includes Ebrard, González, Kershenobich, Bárcena and Ruiz. On Nov 17 she was scheduled to address the APEC Business Advisory Council on Plan México and to meet Xi Jinping and Canada's Mark Carney. She plans to return by Nov 20. No outcome of the Xi meeting had been reported when this entry was written.
